## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_26_electrician_the_bulb_guide",
  "text": "I wrote the bulb guide today for the Courier and the Mechanic. The guide is: look for a tube, not a bulb. Look for T5 or T8 fluorescent tubes, 18 watts or 36 watts, 54 centimetres or 120 centimetres. Look for the bi-pin connector at both ends. Look for the manufacturer label. Do not take a tube that is blackened at the ends — that is a tube that has failed. Do not take a tube that is cracked. Take tubes that are in sealed sleeves or boxes. Take as many as you can carry. The ballasts are the other thing. A tube needs a ballast. Our fixtures have ballasts. If the ballasts are the failure, not the tubes, then the tubes we have are fine and the ballasts are the problem. I do not know if the ballasts are the problem. The flicker on bed B could be the tube or the ballast. I cannot test the ballast without a working tube to swap in. I have one working tube and it is the one that is flickering. If I swap it out to test the ballast, I lose the light. I will not lose the light to test the ballast. The guide says: take tubes and take ballasts if you find them. The ballasts are small metal boxes with two wires. I drew a picture. The Mechanic will know the box. The Courier will know the picture. The picture is a rectangle with two lines coming out. That is a ballast. I have done what I can. The rest is the walk and the finding. I am an electrician. I make things work. I cannot make a bulb that does not exist. I am going on the expedition because I am the one who knows the bulb. The General said the Electrician goes. I said the Electrician goes. The Electrician is me. I am going. I will leave the LED array on the wheat. The Botanist will watch it. The LED is 5 percent. The wheat will survive. The wheat is the proof. I am the practice. The practice is going to find a bulb.",
  "timestamp": "Day 190, 22h",
  "author_name": "The Electrician",
  "author_id": "the_electrician",
  "knowledge_key": "electrician_bulb_guide_going_on_expedition",
  "day": 190,
  "hour": 22.0
}
```
